Congress Amendments 2026 
 
British Perspectives  
 
1.​ Add after paragraph 13 and renumber (London - Russell Square) 
 
But the plans of the European imperialists to remilitarise are fraught with problems. 
Despite their best efforts, they are still being outstripped militarily by Russia. On the 
one hand, the crisis of European capitalism means they can’t afford the €800 billion 
that Brussels has proposed in additional defence spending. On the other hand, the 
long-term deindustrialisation of Britain and Europe has hindered their ability to ramp 
up arms production. This has been accelerated by the Ukraine war and the energy 
crisis that followed, which has led to factory closures across the continent. As a 
result, this much-vaunted rearmament has been a flop. There are splits amongst the 
European ruling classes about how to achieve “war-readiness” – either rebuilding 
their war industries (over decades) or continuing to rely on imports of ready-made 
equipment. These tensions between the European powers will only intensify in the 
coming period. 
 
CC recommendation: Reject in favour of amendment 2 (removal of highlighted sentence)​
